questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If a wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and yield the right-of-way at the intersection. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a Y intersection is ahead. You must stay to the right or left as the road splits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a curve in the road is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show driver intent when turn signals are not available. A left arm extended straight out means the driver plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or steering, and increase your distance from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means the rider ahead wants you to follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. This sign warns that a lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The road dips at the tracks, and low vehicles may scrape or get stuck.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending. Traffic must move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the circle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on a green light that they do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive with caution through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has multiple curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that traffic is moving in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes, move over to make space for traffic entering from the side. Change lanes only if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that the road is one-way traffic only. Do not enter from the direction you are approaching.
